summary: Nick and Chandler discuss five unusual businesses: cake gifting for sales teams, a mobile dog gym, an AI history video channel, cat products and premium matchmaking. Chandler adds pressure washing and AI implementation as side-hustle ideas, then describes how partnerships and AI tools support his publishing business. The conversation emphasizes high-value problems, recurring revenue, low SKU counts and finding customers through existing audiences. Most figures for the featured businesses are reported by the host from external sources; Chandler gives more first-hand detail about his own business and experiments.
